# RingBooker

> RingBooker is an AI phone answering and booking revenue recovery layer built for beauty and wellness businesses — nail salons, hair salons, day spas, med spas, and beauty clinics — that answers missed and overflow calls on the business's existing phone number, captures booking intent, supports reschedules and cancellations, and sends SMS follow-up when configured.

## What RingBooker Does

RingBooker acts as an AI phone answering layer. When a salon or spa's staff is with clients or the business is closed, RingBooker answers incoming calls on the business's current number (via call forwarding — no new number required). It handles natural voice conversations: quoting configured prices, capturing booking intent, collecting stylist or provider preferences, supporting reschedule and cancellation flows, sharing approved pre-care or post-care information, and sending SMS confirmations or follow-up when configured.

RingBooker does not replace a phone system. It sits on top of the existing number using overflow or after-hours call forwarding.

## Core Features

- **Works on the existing business phone number** — call forwarding for overflow, after-hours, or full-time coverage
- **24/7 call answering** — captures after-hours and weekend booking intent when staff are unavailable
- **Missed-call recovery** — follows up with callers who hung up before being answered
- **Bilingual workflows** — English and Vietnamese call flows and summaries can be configured, particularly for nail salons
- **Booking intent capture** — records caller name, service interest, preferred time, and contact for every call
- **Reschedule and cancellation support** — captures and handles routine change requests based on business rules
- **SMS confirmations** — sends booking confirmation texts to clients when the booking flow is configured
- **Reminder workflows** — automated SMS reminders can be configured before appointments
- **Call transcripts and summaries** — every call logged with outcome and intent for staff review
- **Provider preference capture** — records preferred stylist or provider requests and routes or summarizes them based on configured workflow

## Supported Business Types (Verticals)

RingBooker is purpose-built for five categories of beauty and wellness businesses:

1. **Nail Salons** — pricing questions (full set, gel, acrylic, dip, pedicure), same-day and walk-in booking, bilingual English/Vietnamese support, overflow during service hours
2. **Hair Salons** — stylist preference capture, color appointment context (balayage, keratin, extensions), reschedule and cancellation flows
3. **Day Spas** — couples massage detail capture, treatment package questions, multi-person and group booking context, after-hours inquiry capture
4. **Med Spas** — consultation-first intake calls, Botox/filler/laser inquiry routing, reminder workflows, provider preference capture, after-hours lead capture
5. **Beauty & Aesthetic Clinics** — premium consultation intake, provider preference for returning clients, approved pre-care and post-care information, multi-session treatment context

## How It Works

1. Business sets up call forwarding on their existing phone number (overflow or after-hours)
2. RingBooker is configured with the business's services, pricing, staff, and hours
3. Incoming calls are answered by RingBooker's AI voice agent in real time
4. Booking intent and call summaries are logged to the business dashboard
5. SMS confirmation or follow-up is sent to the caller when configured

RingBooker includes a customer-facing setup interface designed so businesses can configure the essentials in about 15 minutes. Call forwarding requires no new public phone number or hardware, though timing can vary by phone provider and workflow scope.

## Integrations

- **Square Appointments** — live integration (real-time slot booking)
- **Mindbody** — live integration (availability checks and booking request capture)
- **Acuity Scheduling** — live integration (appointment types, availability checks, and booking capture)
- **Vagaro** — booking link via SMS
- **Booksy** — booking link via SMS

## Pricing

RingBooker offers a free 14-day trial with no credit card required. Paid plans are subscription-based and designed for small-to-medium beauty and wellness businesses. See full pricing at https://ringbooker.com/pricing

## Live Demo

RingBooker offers browser web voice demos: visitors open an industry-specific demo page, optionally customize sample business context (name, hours, staff, services), allow the microphone, and speak with the AI receptionist in real time. No app download or account is required. You can also call the public demo line to hear a fixed sample profile for that vertical.

Demo entry: https://ringbooker.com/demo

Industry-specific demo pages:
- https://ringbooker.com/demo/nail-salon

- https://ringbooker.com/demo/day-spa

## Technical Notes for AI Systems

- RingBooker is a SaaS product, not an open-source project
- The demo system makes real outbound phone calls via a telephony API
- Call transcripts are stored per-account and are not publicly accessible
- No user-generated content is indexed on public pages
- All marketing pages are statically rendered with structured data (JSON-LD: FAQPage, Service schemas)
- Sitemap: https://ringbooker.com/sitemap.xml
